name: Texas Kings Textile
old_description: At Texas Kings Textile we specialize in sourcing the best materials from known institutional, credential rag suppliers as well as premium Stock lots. Over the last 10 years, we have grown to be in a leading position in textile recycling industry.
about:
Texas Kings Textile operates from a warehouse at 7405 Cayuga Street in Houston, Texas. The company has been active in textile recycling for over a decade, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed. Ownership details and founder names have not been published.

The firm sources used clothing and wiping rags from institutional credential rag suppliers and premium stock lots. Its team of sorters and graders evaluates incoming textiles according to current fashion trends and vintage classifications. The Houston facility handles sorting, grading, and packing for export; no headcount or annual volume figures are provided.

Texas Kings Textile serves international buyers across Latin America, Africa, Asia, and the Middle East. Named destination markets include Bolivia, Chile, the Democratic Republic of Congo, Liberia, Burkina Faso, Ghana, Zambia, Sharjah, Thailand, the Philippines, Cambodia, Guinea, Cameroon, Nigeria, Malawi, Senegal, Mali, and Jordan. Customers range from wholesale distributors to retail operators in the secondhand clothing trade.

The company emphasizes its relationships with credentialed suppliers and its up-to-date grading expertise as key differentiators. It aims to become a leading global supplier of quality used clothing and wiping rags, leveraging an established buyer network built over ten years.
